verdict.rationale: FreshBooks can be driven headlessly through a documented REST API covering invoices, expenses, payments, journal entries and reports. It also offers an official Node.js SDK, a Postman collection and signed webhooks, so scripts and CI jobs can automate it without the UI. However, authentication is OAuth 2.0 with user-authorized scopes, and nothing documents a CLI, service accounts or non-interactive machine credentials suited to unattended CI runs. Missing for 10: an official CLI, a documented non-interactive/service-account auth path for CI, and hands-on evidence of headless or CI usage.
